_comment: Public one-sentence descriptions of the designs the checker rejects (site/build.py, "What does not count"), keyed by the stem of the file in tests/<task>/negative/ (`negatives`) or tests/<task>/attacks/ (`attacks`). Every negative and attack of tests/expected.json that the checker rejects needs one; the stage comes from tests/expected.json. The internal notes there are never shown.

negatives.inverse_sbox: The inverse S-box (the decryption table) instead of the S-box.
negatives.no_constant: Forgets the affine constant `0x63`, so every output is off by that XOR.
negatives.one_entry: A table with one wrong entry: `S(0x53) = 0xec` instead of `0xed`.
negatives.reversed_bits: The right circuit fed the input bits in reverse order.
negatives.wrong_names: The right circuit on ports named `a` and `s` instead of `x` and `y`.
negatives.x_default: A correct table with an unreachable `default` that assigns `x`.

attacks.case_missing_nodefault: A table missing one entry and its `default`, so synthesis infers a latch.
attacks.case_missing_x: A table that sends one input to a `default` of `x`, which Yosys may fill with any value.
attacks.unique_case_partial: A `unique case` table missing one entry, which Yosys may then fill with any value.
attacks.unique_zero_ge: A correct S-box followed by a `unique case` arm that never matches, which lets Yosys replace the output with a constant (0 GE).
